title: LID IS BAD, CUP IS PRETTY. READ THE OTHER REVIEWS, TOO.
text:
LID IS BAD, CUP IS PRETTY. READ THE OTHER REVIEWS, TOO.. I recently bought three cups like this, different brands. This lid is the hardest to put on, and the tightest to open and close. The mouth opening isn't bad. If it had a better lid, it would get a better rating. I'll keep the cup, though I probably shouldn't. Don't drop it on a tile floor, as the lid will chip easily. If I could find a better replacement lid, it would be perfect. I'm sure it exists somewhere, but I shouldn't have to replace a brand new lid for something that works.
Editing to add, and increase to three stars : After using it a little while, you get used to the lid. My suggestion is to leave the lid on when the cup is not in use. The gasket will adjust, and the next time you put it on it will be easier. I suggest starting with the mouth area, then pushing the back down after. I hope this helps. The size of the cup is excellent. Still wish the lid went on easier.
